path: 上達のためのテクニック

intro.ja:
アヒル囲いは低いバランス型で、金銀の打ち込みの隙を減らし、大駒を交換して攻めを続ける構想と結び付きます。音無しの構えは角道を開けずに組み、後で引き角を使います。多伝囲い（銀多伝）は主に二枚落ちの下手の定跡に現れ、平手の囲いと同じ条件で評価してはいけません。

串カツは玉を角の線から外す一方で端攻めに弱く、ちょんまげ美濃は伸ばした二筋歩、坊主美濃は消えた二筋歩が玉頭の問題になります。無敵囲い（最強囲い）という名前は強さの保証ではなく、初心者が作りがちな形を指す通称です。名前より、金銀の連結、玉の逃げ道、打ち込みと攻めの方向を確認します。
intro.en:
Duck castle uses a low balanced setup to reduce general-drop entry points and supports attacks that may exchange major pieces. Silent Formation develops without opening the bishop diagonal, then uses a retreating bishop plan. Silver Taden belongs chiefly to the lower-side repertoire in two-piece handicap. Its success there does not establish the same value in even play, where the missing enemy rook and bishop are present.

Kushikatsu avoids a bishop line at the cost of edge vulnerability. Topknot Mino’s advanced second-file pawn and Bald Mino’s absent one create distinct frontal weaknesses. Invincible Castle, also called Strongest Castle, is a nickname for a familiar beginner arrangement, not a guarantee of strength. Assess connected generals, king escape routes, drop squares, and the likely direction of attack rather than trusting a memorable name.

question.ja: 「無敵囲い」という名称から、囲いの堅さを判断できますか？
question.en: Can the name Invincible Castle establish its defensive strength?

answer.ja: できません。具体的な連結、逃げ道、弱点を調べて評価します。
answer.en: No. Evaluate its actual connections, escape routes, and weaknesses.

courses.title: マイナーな囲い一覧: 図1-1 アヒル囲い
courses.titleEn: Unusual castles and their tradeoffs: Figure 1-1: Duck castle
courses.goalFormation:
図1-1 アヒル囲い
図1-1は「アヒル囲い」で、中住まいのような陣形の囲いです。金銀の打ち込みがないのが特徴で、大駒を切ってでも攻めをつなげる順を狙います。この囲いを使った戦法をアヒル戦法と言い、奇襲戦法の一つです。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

root.commentEn:
Figure 1-1: Duck castle
Figure 1-1 is the "duck castle" (アヒル囲い), a Nakazumai-like formation. Its feature is that it has no gold or silver drops, and it aims for sequences that keep the attack going even by sacrificing major pieces. A strategy using it is the Duck strategy, one of the surprise strategies.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

courses.title: マイナーな囲い一覧: 図1-2 音無しの構え

図1-2 音無しの構え
銀冠穴熊のような囲いですが、角道を開けずに組むのが「音無しの構え」です。角道を開けないので隙ができにくいのが特徴です。ここからは引き角にして使うのが基本です。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

root.commentEn:
Figure 1-2: Silent stance
Otonashi no Kamae looks like a Ginkanmuri Anaguma but is built without opening the bishop's diagonal. Not opening the diagonal makes weaknesses less likely. From here the bishop is basically used by retreating it.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

Figure 1-4: Kushikatsu castle
The Kushikatsu castle swaps the king and lance positions of Static Rook Anaguma. It takes the king off the opponent's bishop line, but is quite weak to edge attacks.

root.commentEn:
Figure 1-5: Chonmage Mino
A Mino castle with the 2nd-file pawn pushed is called Chonmage Mino. It is used in the feint Ranging Rook strategy that looks like Static Rook, but the 2nd-file pawn is merely a weakness and should be dealt with.

courses.title: マイナーな囲い一覧: 図1-7 無敵囲い
courses.titleEn: Unusual castles and their tradeoffs: Figure 1-7: Invincible castle
courses.goalFormation:
図1-7 無敵囲い
図1-7の囲いを「無敵囲い」と言い、将棋を覚えたての人が自己流で囲うとこの形になりがちです。まったく無敵ではなく強い囲いとは言えませんが、いつまでも初心者を卒業できずにこの囲いを愛用する人を皮肉って名付けられ、「最強囲い」とも呼ばれます。漫画『ハチワンダイバー』で使われ、広まりました。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

root.commentEn:
Figure 1-7: Invincible castle
The castle in Figure 1-7 is called the "invincible castle" (無敵囲い). People new to shogi tend to end up with this shape when castling by themselves. It is not invincible at all and cannot be called strong; the name ironically refers to people who never graduate from being beginners and love this castle. It is also called the "strongest castle", and the name spread through the manga Hachi-One Diver.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.
